about: WILD CROWN 음원 제작 목록. 프롬프트가 원본이다. ElevenLabs 웹 앱에서 생성(계획서 docs/plans/2026-11-11-slot-chess-village-plan.md §9-2). 원본 후보는 저장소 밖 D:/tmp/wc-audio/raw 에 받는다.

sfx.prompt: A single deep, round, satisfying thud of a giant seashell slot reel locking into place, followed by a short watery splash tail. Cute, cartoonish, warm, not scary. One hit only.
A cute cartoon animal plopping into the sea: one big round splash with a bubbly, playful tail and a tiny rising bubble pop at the end. Bright, soft, friendly, not harsh.
Giant seashells rising out of the sea: a rushing column of water whooshing upward with bubbles and a soft sparkle at the top. Cartoon game sound, round and friendly, about one second.

sfx.use: ① 세 번째 릴 멈춤 쾅
sfx.prompt: Big final slot reel lock: one heavy, round, wooden-shell thump with a bright sparkling chime burst and a small water splash right after. Triumphant, cute, cartoonish, not harsh.
Crown-shaped water fountain burst: a quick upward spray of water with glittering magical shimmer falling like droplets. Short, bright, celebratory, cute game sound.
Sticker slap: a clear, punchy paper sticker slapped onto a wooden board with a cute rubbery pop. Crisp and loud, about one second, cartoon game user interface sound.
sfx.note: 첫 프롬프트(tiny soft paper smack… Very short)는 후보 넷이 모두 거의 무음이라 11-12 에 고쳐 다시 뽑음

sfx.prompt: Tiny dangling tag jiggling: a quick light rattle of paper and a very small jingle bell shaking twice. Short, cute, subtle game sound.
Soft electric charge-up: a short rising crackle and gentle buzzing hum building for half a second, like a tiny friendly storm cloud getting ready. Not scary, no thunder boom.
Twinkling star aim lock-on: a quick rising glassy shimmer ending in one bright high ping. Short, magical, cute game sound.
Wet ink brush swish: one quick smooth brush stroke on paper with a soft watery bloom at the end. Short, calm, satisfying.
Bubbly foam burst: a seashell popping open with a round pop and a spray of many tiny fizzing bubbles. Short, soft, playful cartoon impact.
Small firework pop up close: one soft bang followed by crackling sparkles fading out. Cute, round, not loud or sharp, cartoon game impact.
Party confetti popper: one light pop with a flutter of paper pieces falling. Short, cheerful, soft, cartoon game sound.
Friendly cartoon whale surfacing: a big gentle watery swell, a soft low happy whoo call, and a spout of water spraying. Warm, round, not scary.
Distant fireworks over the sea at a small island festival: a few soft booms with crackling sparkle tails, heard from far away. Warm, gentle, celebratory, no crowd.
Wooden raft gently bumping onto a sandy beach: creaking logs, a soft thud on wet sand, and small waves lapping. Short, cozy, cartoon game sound.
Cute workshop mallet: one bright wooden mallet tap on a small metal piece with a pleasant ringing ting. Short, clean, satisfying, toy-like.
Bouncy crafted part: a springy boing as a small object pops up, then a neat click as it lands in place. Short, playful, cartoon.
Little crowd of cute cartoon animals cheering yay together with a few claps. Short, happy, high and soft voices, not human sounding.
Hush transition: a soft downward whoosh as if the air goes quiet, ending in a low gentle underwater hum. Short, tense but calm, no impact.
Handful of acorns scattering: several small wooden nuts bouncing on a wooden board and dropping into a cloth pouch. Short, light, satisfying, cartoon.
Ripple of tiny hops: a fast run of many small soft boing jumps sweeping from left to right like a stadium wave, with a light whoosh. Short, cute, cartoon.
Golden magical shimmer swell: warm glowing chimes rising and blooming into one rich bell tone, like treasure being revealed. Short, bright, cute game sound.
Ta-da craft complete: a bright two-note marimba flourish with a small anvil ring and sparkle. Short, proud, cute game reward sound.
Three second game jingle to start a round: playful ukulele strum and marimba run going up, ending on a bright open chord. Cute, sunny, instrumental.
Victory sting for a cute animal chess game: short triumphant marimba, ukulele and steel pan fanfare ending on a happy major chord with a cymbal shimmer. About three seconds, instrumental.
Gentle defeat sting for a cute game: soft descending marimba and ukulele phrase, a little sad but kind and encouraging, ending softly. About three seconds, instrumental.
Island festival sting: lively steel pan and hand drum burst with shakers, joyful and dancing, ending with a bright hit. About four seconds, instrumental.

Night tropical beach ambience: slow soft waves, quiet crickets, occasional tiny water sparkle. Peaceful, dark, steady, no music, no voices, seamless loop.

Cozy island village ambience: light breeze in palm leaves, distant gentle hammering and wooden creaks, soft chatter of small cute animals far away, a wind chime now and then. Warm, steady, no music, seamless loop.
